output.reason: The linked PR [ev-515ad4802a5d] names the subject: the kind and name filters and resource counts in the Argo CD UI's application resource tree when Group Nodes is turned on. The changed files back this up: application-resource-filter.tsx and application-resource-tree.tsx [ev-28a9374387f3]. The PR also says what was wrong: grouping replaced the individual child pods with a podGroup, so the filter could not reach them, and filtering by kind or pod name and the counts gave wrong results; the fix makes them work. Applicability is a UI-only condition with no setting attached: someone views an application's resource tree with Group Nodes on. The only consequence of doing nothing is that the old wrong display goes away, which an engineer can write as an informational UI fix [ev-1cef98424a3e].
